amends: CA-16 review brief, Scope Verification item 1 (exactly two new files: src/foundation/SessionIndexes.ts and src/foundation/SessionCompaction.ts)

precedent.note: Measured by conformance gate C9, not estimated. These are the accepted, reviewed, in-tree sibling capabilities for derived SQLite indexes.
precedent.conclusion: The accepted runtime journal index is 701 lines across 8 files with a 4-line barrel. Two owned files at the 300-line foundation hard-reject ceiling permit 600 lines in total. The session index is strictly larger in scope than the runtime index: seven tables against one projection, plus capsules and compaction. The two-file scope is therefore not reachable by any decomposition, and the precedent fixes both the shape and the location.

namingRules.source: engineering-and-review-standard.md - class-owning TypeScript modules use PascalCase filenames; function/value modules use lowerCamelCase; new source filenames do not use dashes or underscores.

modules.responsibility: Public surface of the session-index capability tree. Re-exports only; owns no behavior.
The closed table registry, column types, enums, and the index_meta identity row set. Declarations only, no I/O.
Reads the CA-15 operator-session tree (identity, JSONL journal, turn content) and computes journal checkpoints. The only module that touches journal, turn, and proposal bytes.
modules.mirrors: src/foundation/index/runtime/journalIndexSource.ts (55 lines); larger because CA-15's format is multi-file and validated from unknown

sizeException.reason: The CORRECTION-03 map sized this module against src/foundation/index/runtime/journalIndexSource.ts (55) and journalIndexRows.ts (48), which consume an already-typed DurableEvent. CA-16 consumes CA-15's multi-file operator-session tree from unknown bytes: identity, JSONL journal envelope, per-turn response/snapshot/usage sidecars, turn content, and proposals, each admitted fail-closed. The reader already binds CA-15's own accepted validators (parseSession, readJournalFile, isTurnRecord) rather than transcribing the format, so no further reduction is available without either deleting required fail-closed validation or adding an owned module, which this amendment does not do.

modules.responsibility: build and incrementalUpdate plus the query and capsule facade: sequences source, rows, and the derived store through the accepted staged rebuild and atomic switch, and admits before querying and before extending a generation.
The bounded typed queries named by the CA-16 brief, over bounded indexed reads, with the shared cursor and the section 9.4 result envelope.
Cross-session capsule construction and full capsule.schema.json validation: lane equality, prune resolution, excerpt and omission labelling, non-transitivity.

Derived-store lifecycle: open, fail-closed admission in two halves (admitGeneration = integrity, semantic root, index_meta identity; admitStore = that plus journal continuity), atomic manifest publication, and compaction with cross-session proposal preservation.
modules.mirrors: no direct sibling; sized as a foundation service
